name: Melbourne
housing: Melbourne renters live in inner-city apartments, older brick flats and Victorian terrace houses and cottages, with houses in the outer suburbs.

localRules.text: In Victoria the bond must be lodged with the Residential Tenancies Bond Authority (RTBA), which sends the renter a receipt.

climate: Melbourne weather changes fast, so test both heating and cooling and check for draughts and mould.
fact: Melbourne's weather is known for having four seasons in one day.
